name: 86403 · Lk Havasu Cty, AZ
findings: ZIP 86403 (Lk Havasu Cty) has 84 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 86403 (Lk Havasu Cty) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 86403 (Lk Havasu Cty) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
